Completeness.description:
Whether a Run's results cover everything in its scope (ADRs 0005 and
0029).

oneOf.description: They do.
The Run ended early.
It finished, but the engine cannot vouch that nothing was missed.

DaemonEndpoint.description:
Where a Daemon or an Attached engine's private endpoint listens (ADR
0024): a `0600` Unix socket on macOS and Linux, loopback TCP on
Windows.

oneOf.description: A Unix socket's path.
A loopback address and port.
It runs.

It ended early: by a Limit, an abort, its timeout, the loss of its
engine or exhausted resources.
It reached its end.
An error in the engine or the program's code ended it.

PointInTime.description: A point in time in UTC, as RFC 3339.

Presence.description:
Whether the state a Run index row points at is there (ADRs 0031 and
0036).

oneOf.description: Its state is at its location.
`runs reindex` found no state at its location; the row is kept.

The Run was discarded on purpose; `runs reindex` keeps its row
erased.

PrivateEndpoint.description:
An Attached engine's private endpoint (ADRs 0024 and 0031): where it
listens, a `0600` Unix socket on macOS and Linux or loopback TCP on
Windows, and the `0600` file holding the token that each Connection's
`hello` there carries, as a Daemon's does.

token_file.description: The path of the file holding its token.

Product.description:
One of Goodfetch's two Products (ADR 0084), by its mark as the catalog
writes it.

oneOf.description: Browser automation; Foxhound contains it.
Crawling, which contains Collie.

RunId.description: A Run ID (ADR 0036): lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting and ending with a letter or a digit, never a name Windows reserves for a device.

RunIndexRow.description:
One row of the Run index (ADR 0031): a Run, where its state is, its three
axes and, while it is live, the engine that owns it.

kind.description: What kind of Run it is.

location.description:
Its folder: relative to the per-major data folder when it is inside,
absolute otherwise.

owner.description:
While it is live, where the engine that owns it is reached: a
Daemon's endpoint, or an Attached engine's private endpoint. An
engine that cannot take the Run's writer lock forwards live actions
there.

presence.description: Whether its state is at its location.

progress_message.description: The program's own status line, once it set one (RT-15).

RunKind.description:
What kind of Run it is: a Collie Run its program drives, or a crawl
(ADR 0102), which its start's inputs name.

oneOf.description: A Run its program drives page by page.
A crawl, whose work items the engine leases to its handlers.

RunOwner.description: Where the engine that owns a live Run is reached (ADR 0031).

oneOf.description:
A Daemon, at the endpoint of its runtime file, which also holds its
token.
An Attached engine, at its private endpoint.

Tag.description: An opaque text a Run is tagged with (ADR 0036).

Tags.description: A Run's tags, in the order given.

Verdict.description: Whether a Run's own checks prove what it committed (ADR 0029).

oneOf.description:
Every check the Run relies on passed, none was switched off, and no
Effect is left uncertain.
A declared Success check failed.
Everything else: a person reviews it.
